articles.title: Laws inconsistent with fundamental rights to be void
articles.content: All existing law inconsistent with the provisions of this Part shall, to the extent of such inconsistency, become void.

articles.title: Equality before law
articles.content: All citizens are equal before law and are entitled to equal protection of law.

articles.title: Discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth
articles.content: The State shall not discriminate against any citizen on grounds only of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth. Women shall have equal rights with men in all spheres of the State and of public life.

articles.title: Right to protection of law
articles.content: To enjoy the protection of the law, and to be treated in accordance with law, and only in accordance with law, is the inalienable right of every citizen, and of every other person for the time being within Bangladesh.

articles.title: Protection of right to life and personal liberty
articles.content: No person shall be deprived of life or personal liberty save in accordance with law.

articles.title: Safeguards as to arrest and detention
articles.content: No person who is arrested shall be detained in custody without being informed, as soon as may be, of the grounds for such arrest, nor shall he be denied the right to consult and be defended by a legal practitioner of his choice. Every person arrested shall be produced before the nearest magistrate within twenty-four hours.

articles.title: Protection in respect of trial and punishment
articles.content: No person shall be convicted of any offence except for violation of a law in force at the time of the commission of the act charged. Every person accused of a criminal offence shall have the right to a speedy and public trial by an independent and impartial court or tribunal.

articles.title: Freedom of movement
articles.content: Subject to reasonable restrictions imposed by law, every citizen shall have the right to move freely throughout Bangladesh, to reside and settle in any place therein and to leave and re-enter Bangladesh.

articles.title: Freedom of assembly
articles.content: Every citizen shall have the right to assemble and to participate in public meetings and processions peacefully and without arms.

articles.title: Freedom of association
articles.content: Every citizen shall have the right to form associations or unions, subject to any reasonable restrictions imposed by law in the interests of morality or public order.

articles.title: Freedom of thought and conscience, and of speech
articles.content: Freedom of thought and conscience is guaranteed. The right of every citizen to freedom of speech and expression, and freedom of the press, are guaranteed subject to reasonable restrictions imposed by law.

articles.title: Freedom of profession or occupation
articles.content: Every citizen shall have the right to enter upon any lawful profession or occupation, and to conduct any lawful trade or business.

articles.title: Freedom of religion
articles.content: Every citizen has the right to profess, practise or propagate any religion. Every religious community or denomination has the right to establish, maintain and manage its religious institutions.

articles.title: Rights to property
articles.content: Every citizen shall have the right to acquire, hold, transfer or otherwise dispose of property, and no property shall be compulsorily acquired, nationalised or requisitioned save by authority of law.

articles.title: Enforcement of fundamental rights
articles.content: The right to move the High Court Division in accordance with clause (1) of article 102, for the enforcement of the rights conferred by this Part is guaranteed.
